title: precision test-equipment surfaces and stock

specimens.name: Light-gray precision-painted steel electronics plate
specimens.description: TOP ROW CELL 1 ONLY. Clean rectangular light-gray serial steel plate for electronic/test equipment with smooth controlled factory paint, precise straight factory edges and a calm uninterrupted face; no holes, cutouts, ribs, ventilation, fasteners, attached hardware, rust, heavy chipping or distressed wear

specimens.name: Beige-gray molded ABS/PC technical panel
specimens.description: TOP ROW CELL 2 ONLY. Rigid beige-gray molded technical-plastic panel for laboratory/test equipment with a neat molded perimeter edge and exactly one small functional stiffening rib; industrial instrumentation plastic, not consumer-product styling, no cutouts, buttons, connectors, text or attached hardware

specimens.name: Anodized aluminium instrument faceplate blank
specimens.description: TOP ROW CELL 3 ONLY. Flat instrumentation-grade anodized aluminium faceplate blank with precise machined outer edges and a restrained set of clean functional cutouts of different sizes; no instruments, switches, buttons, connectors, labels, text, screws or attached components

specimens.name: Precision-folded electronics chassis fragment
specimens.description: TOP ROW CELL 4 ONLY. Short purpose-built sheet-metal electronics chassis fragment with several precise factory 90-degree folds, repeatable geometry and clean formed flanges for dense test electronics; clearly more specialized than a simple folded-sheet coupon, but not a complete enclosure, rack, cabinet or machine

specimens.name: Perforated ventilation sheet coupon
specimens.description: BOTTOM ROW CELL 1 ONLY. Rectangular metal sheet coupon with a regular factory-made array of identical ventilation perforations, clean edges and even finish; only perforated sheet stock, not a finished grille, fan, filter, frame, cover or housing

specimens.name: Short anodized aluminium rack-mount profile
specimens.description: BOTTOM ROW CELL 2 ONLY. Short specialized anodized aluminium mounting profile for test/rack equipment with repeatable extruded geometry and one regular row of mounting holes along its mounting flange; not a generic angle/U-channel/box section, not a full rack, rail assembly, cabinet or enclosure

specimens.name: Molded glass-filled nylon spacer/support block
specimens.description: BOTTOM ROW CELL 3 ONLY. Single dark-gray molded glass-filled-nylon engineering support block with a compact purpose-built shape, one functional mounting bore or seating point and restrained structural ribbing; no metal inserts, stacked pieces, phenolic brown material, consumer styling or attached hardware

specimens.name: Precision die-cut EPDM/silicone isolation pad
specimens.description: BOTTOM ROW CELL 4 ONLY. Flat dark EPDM/silicone vibration-isolation or sealing pad with a precise die-cut rectangular outline, one large central functional opening and four small mounting holes near the corners; clean technical gasket/isolation part, not a generic ribbed neoprene slab, roll, hose or molded block

global_forbidden: text, letters, numbers, logos or pseudo-writing
whole racks, electronic cabinets, computers, CRTs, machines, vehicles, complete buildings, laboratories, rooms or staged scenes
any ninth or extra specimen, duplicate specimen, omitted specimen, merged specimen, substitution, or reinterpretation of one listed specimen as another
baked cast shadows, contact shadows, glow, bloom, rays or temporary FX
bolts or screws as standalone specimens, hinges, hatches, assembled ventilation grilles, fans, filters, connectors, cables, motors, controls, displays, instruments or lamps
generic L-angle, generic U-channel or generic square box-section stock except the explicitly listed specialized rack-mount profile
wood, transparent glass, carbon-fiber composite, glossy consumer plastic, foam, raw timber, phenolic brown spacer stock, generic ribbed neoprene pads or any unlisted material class
visible rust, orange oxidation, heavy chipping, distressed patina, dirt-dominant wear or hand-cut scars
photorealistic PBR material-catalog rendering, filtered 3D-render appearance or soft studio-product photography

era_contract.character: specialized late-1990s aerospace test-equipment construction: precision sheet-metal fabrication, instrumentation aluminium, beige/gray technical plastics, rack-specific mounting language, regular ventilation stock and purpose-built engineering polymers/isolation materials
required_signals: precision repeatable factory fabrication for electronic/test equipment
steel and anodized aluminium combined with beige/gray technical plastics
rack-specific mounting geometry rather than generic workshop stock
regular industrial ventilation perforation and electronics-service material language
purpose-built engineering polymer support and precision isolation/gasket materials
replaced_previous_language: generic E1 factory-painted workshop plate and simple folded-sheet stock
generic galvanized angle, U-channel and square box-section profiles as the dominant stock language
workshop-centric material vocabulary without explicit test-electronics specialization
forbidden_regressions: safety-yellow simple folded coupon, generic galvanized L-profile, generic U-channel or generic square box-section standing in for the E2 electronics-specific pieces
brown phenolic spacer replacing the glass-filled-nylon support
simple ribbed neoprene slab replacing the precision die-cut isolation pad
olive-heavy workshop stock, rough hand fabrication, rust or distressed wear as the main era cue
cleaner E1-only styling without rack, precision electronics, technical-plastic or specialized isolation language
